subject: cat
scope: Actual source, selected design, and four revision key stills only. No video playback inspected; this is not playback approval.

timed_key_evidence.evidence: Raised three-quarter head and unequal polygon eyes preserve the source upward/right attention in the sparse polygon-face vocabulary; two pointed ears and long straight whiskers retain the selected drawing identity.
The attentive raised head remains in the same framing and orientation, matching the source held attention.
The third key retains the held raised face and readable neck/chest support without adding unsupported visible limbs.

The final key turns substantially toward screen right: the muzzle projects right, the far eye compresses against the contour, and the ears and whiskers follow the new view. This preserves the consequential source turn.

protected_strengths: Irregular polygon head and polygon eye shapes remain recognizable from the selected QuickDraw design.
Sparse black line treatment, pointed ears, and straight whiskers survive the pose reconstruction.
The final right turn is distinct from the first three held attention keys.
limits: The empty polygon eyes communicate attention chiefly through head orientation; these stills cannot establish blink timing, transition quality, or normal-speed motion.
